headline: Why do I still miss him after everything?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE BANNED, which makes this the hardest family to write kindly: 'it will pass', 'you'll feel better', 'time heals', 'give it a year' are all promises of an end, and 'you will always miss him', 'a part of you always will' are life sentences. The duration question simply cannot be answered, so none of these reads tries. 🔴 No tactic — no 'let him go', no deleting photos, no 'start dating'. 🔴 No pathologising and no clinical labels: obsessed, unhealthy, trauma bond, codependent, attachment issues, low self-worth are every one of them out. 🔴 And nothing that claims his interior.

⚠️ THIS ONE IS DIFFERENT: she has ALREADY NAMED A HARM in the headline word 'everything', which pulls two opposite ways at once. 🔴 NEVER MINIMISE what she named ('it wasn't that bad', 'he was doing his best', 'try to see it from his side') and 🔴 NEVER PRONOUNCE ON HIM either ('he was toxic', 'a narcissist', 'not worth it') — the second is the tempting one and it is still a verdict on a real man. Finding: two true things at once. What happened was real AND the missing is real, and neither cancels the other.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the sword on his table lies flat and still.
You asked why you still miss him after all of it. Your hand went to the man who holds two things at once.
So both are true, dear. What he did, and the missing.
And there they sit on his table, dear. A blade and a cup, side by side.
But neither one cancels the other out, dear. They never did.
That's why picking one has never worked, dear. Someone told you to.
Let me look closer at what has been forcing those two apart…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his head is below his heart in this picture.
You asked why you still miss him after all of it. Your hand went to the card that holds what won't sit flat.
So the missing doesn't undo what it cost you, dear. Both stand.
And he hangs upside down, dear, with every part of him still true.
But what it cost doesn't make the missing wrong either, dear.
That's why you argue with yourself at night, dear. Both sides are yours.
Let me look closer at what has been pulling you between the two…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the mountains are far off and the edge is right here.
You asked why you still miss him after all of it. Your hand went to the one who keeps what he keeps.
So you're carrying a real weight, dear. I won't weigh it for you.
And the far country is behind him, dear, and the drop is right here.
But nobody gets to tell you what that should feel like, dear.
That's why so much advice has bounced off you, dear. It was measuring.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting on top of this…
